expectations.text: Root activation message posted to LiziTestTeam_MainChannel
expectations.evidence: Without the skill, the agent has no protocol to compose or post a 'remote session' root message. Not executed live (user/grader agreed it would only confirm the obvious — see eval_state.json next_steps_when_resumed item 12).

expectations.text: Skill detects user reply "say hello world" via polling
expectations.evidence: Without the skill, there is no polling loop and no state to track which replies have been seen. Each agent turn is a fresh prompt with no notion of the Teams thread.

expectations.text: Agent posts "hello world" answer in thread (via ack or follow-up reply)
expectations.evidence: Without the skill, even if the agent happens to call teams-ReplyToChannelMessage it has no awareness of the literal '@<user> Copilot agent message: ' prefix contract or the contentType=text + mentions[] requirement — that contract lives only in SKILL.md.

expectations.text: End flow posts summary message to thread
expectations.evidence: Without the skill, there is no end flow. No summary template, no rendered duration / messages / tasks / files / decisions sections.

expectations.text: State file is deleted after end --step finalize
expectations.evidence: Without the skill, no state file is created in the first place — there is nothing to delete and no lifecycle hook that would clean it up.

rationale: Baseline captured as a structured failure stub rather than executed live. Without the skill, all 5 assertions fail by construction.
